project_type: Single static HTML file - insurance product page with embedded CSS/JS
build_system: None - single HTML file, no build process
test_framework: None - manual verification by opening in browser
test_command: Validate HTML structure and JS logic via grep/AST checks
verification_instructions: 1. Check that the HTML file is valid and self-contained. 2. Verify calculator logic produces correct results for known test cases. 3. Verify all premium data matches source PDF values.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a single HTML file
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages or access external resources during build. Live exchange rate API will be called at runtime by the user's browser (not during build). Cannot use PDF parsing libraries.
contribution_requirements: File must remain a single self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JS. No external dependencies.
key_patterns: Single HTML file with: embedded <style> block, tab-based navigation (10 tabs), calculator with JavaScript logic, password-protected commission tab, WhatsApp contact links throughout. Premium data stored as JavaScript object (premiumData). Calculator uses interpolation for ages not in the data table.
directory_structure: Single file project: MPS_Flexi_Product.html + reference PDFs in same directory
premium_data_notes: PDF 'B. Tabel Premi MPS Versi Quick PDF (2).pdf' contains premium rates in ribuan (thousands of Rupiah) per 1 juta Rupiah of UP. The PDF has data for ages 0-70, with male and female rates. Plan A (Amanah) supports YRT 1-year, 5-year, and 10-year payment terms. Plans B (Berkah) and C (Cermat) support 5, 10, 15 year terms. Plan B coverage = sampai usia 110 tahun. The extracted data for the 1M (1 juta UP) column shows values like: Age 40 male Plan A YRT-1 = 4.1 ribuan/juta UP = Rp 4,100 per 1 juta UP = Rp 410,000 for 100 juta UP = Rp 4,100,000 for 1 Miliar UP.

plan_a_amanah.notes: YRT - Yearly Renewable Term for 1-year option
